observations.reason: Exact package, immutable data classes, composable API and typed wire format match fixed API; imports are existing Compose/Material3 only. Existing acquisition is hash-bound; no compilation was executed in review.
remember production draft starts with null choice/requested count/false flags, reconciles only on request or revision changes, and resets on new request ID.
Caller-order forEach resolves actual option IDs, excludes unavailable/sent choices, ignores same selection, clamps count and clears acceptance.
Native button handlers adjust by exactly one only inside inclusive bounds and while unsent. Disabled predicates, selection clamp and revised-bound clamp are explicit.

Int arithmetic derives signed balance from current price/prepaid/credit; integer-to-Long magnitude formatting yields ASCII dollar/point and two decimals without grouping. Null/zero/refund/payment render separately.
False initial credit is editable independently of selection while positive and unsent, edit clears acceptance, and reconciliation forces it false for zero credit.
Acceptance clears on selection/quantity/credit/revision edits; switch requires selected available option and unsent state, and canSend also requires accepted.

Current reconciled draft is derived/persisted before UI without keyed recreation. New fields are read directly from model; choice stays only if available and count clamps to current bounds; zero credit clears and acceptance/sent reset.
Only guarded send handler calls onSubmit with exact typed current values, then stores sent; all edit and caller-update paths are silent. Literal wireValue format matches API.
Native default system font uses approved 12/28/13/18/15/26/16/20 sp roles and weights, inheriting Compose font scale without caps. No computed text size is inferred.
Non-scrolling Columns/Rows use root16/section20, cards12/radius16/border1, inside/options8, notes10, footer16 and rootRadius20 dp. Text is unlimited and no fixed text height or ellipsis is set.
Actual Buttons have choice min64, quantity min44x44, send min52 and exact16/14 padding; heightIn/sizeIn preserve vertical growth. This establishes source dimensions only.

Every approved light/dark role is chosen explicitly. Option disabled content uses secondary ink with solid fill, not whole-row opacity; send enabled/disabled roles are explicit. MaterialTheme luminance selects caller theme.
Start alignment/TextAlign.Start and caller list order preserve native direction; no array reversal or forced text direction. Literal strings retain ASCII currency and counts.

Unique test tags belong to actual native Button/Switch targets; option selected/contentDescription is set once, visual descendants are cleared, and summary/canvas do not merge child text. No duplicate UI or style readback.
Fixed bridge decodes required fixture data into production DTO and forwards submission.wireValue without business derivation.
Fixed bridge directly calls imported production MenuChangeReviewPanel at one stable call site with no identity key, cloned view or outer product state.
